premise: Example Lab published a smaller model today and said inference cost fell by about a third against the model it replaces. The post gives two numbers: 34 percent lower cost per million tokens, and a 2.1x throughput gain on commodity CPUs.
summary: Example Lab released a smaller model, claiming a 34 percent lower cost per million tokens and 2.1x the throughput of the model it replaces on commodity CPUs. The weights are published under a permissive licence.
title: Example Lab releases a smaller model
